- fdm-insert-hole-cad-offset-cnckitchen: amount added to the nominal insert hole in CAD so it prints to size: 0.2-0.3 mm | guide conf high [ref:cnck-2026]
  when a printed hole for a small insert; not: a hole drilled after printing takes the maker's hole -> fdm-insert-hole-m3-nominal-cnckitchen
  0.2-0.3 mm; each printer and filament shrinks holes differently, so your coupon governs; cost: test prints until it is right [ref:spirol-3dp], or drill [ref:hubs-3dp-threaded-fasteners]; by inserts.printed_hole, manufacturing.fit_coupons
  applies: small inserts; size so the insert pre-seats with slight resistance (M3 in PLA on one printer, 4.2 mm in CAD kept about 90 % of the highest pull-out force)
  read 2026-10-31
[ref:cnckitchen-heat-set-hole-size] encoded, conf high: Stefan Hermann, Are Our Heat-Set Insert Datasheets Wrong?, CNC Kitchen, 2026: https://cnckitchen.com/blog/are-our-heat-set-insert-datasheets-wrong
  claim: Size the hole so the insert just pre-seats with slight resistance; oversize holes lose pull-out fast (drilled M3: the big drop between 4.1 and 4.2 mm) (encoded)
  claim: Printed holes came out about 0.25 mm under CAD (CORE One L, PolySonic PLA); add 0.2-0.3 mm in CAD for small inserts; every printer and material shrinks holes differently (conflicting)
